$comment: Copy this to profiles/<repo>.json and edit. Your copy is gitignored -- profiles name real
repositories and environments, so they stay on your machine.
The leading underscore keeps this example out of profile matching.

checks.delegate_reason: State the real reason here. It is shown to the user, and an unexplained request to run something by hand gets ignored. Typical reasons: the repository's own docs forbid the agent running it, it needs credentials the session should not spend, or it needs more memory than the session has.

checks.when: the change touches a repository, a schema, or a migration
